title: Carlisle Companies Incorporated Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
summary: Carlisle reported first-half 2026 revenue of USD2.6224 billion, continuing-operations diluted EPS of USD9.43, USD197.1 million operating cash flow, USD665.3 million cash and USD2.8849 billion long-term debt; commercial re-roofing supported volume while raw-material and freight inflation pressured margins.
